bead.title: claude-tui/step2: scaffold internal/harnesses/claude-tui/ + register in builtinHarnesses (stub Execute)
bead.description:
Plan step 2. Package compiles, registers, and implements Harness + the three sub-interfaces with stubs. Execute returns a final event with 'not yet implemented'; QuotaStatus/AccountStatus/DefaultModelSnapshot return zero values or sentinel errors. Conformance suite passes against the stub.

FILES:
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/runner.go: Runner struct + Info/HealthCheck/Execute (stub) + interface method declarations.
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/contract004.go: explicit interface compliance assertions (_ harnesses.QuotaHarness = (*Runner)(nil), etc.) + sub-interface method stubs.
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/contract004_conformance_test.go: runs harnesstest conformance suite against the stub Runner.
- internal/harnesses/registry.go: add 'claude-tui' entry per ADR-013 §Scope (empty BaseArgs/PermissionArgs/Flags; IsSubscription=true; AutoRoutingEligible=false).
- internal/serviceimpl/execute_dispatch.go: extend the dispatcher's harness-name switch to include claude-tui constructing a &claudetui.Runner{}.

NON-SCOPE: PTY transport (sub-bead step 3); real model discovery (sub-bead step 5); real quota plumbing (sub-bead step 4).
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/harnesses/claude-tui/ package compiles.
2) Runner stub behavior: Execute returns a non-nil channel (the dispatcher path is exercised) that emits exactly one final event with Status='error' and a Reason naming 'not yet implemented'. Setup return value is nil — setup does not fail before run path.
3) harnesstest.RunHarnessConformance, RunQuotaHarnessConformance, RunAccountHarnessConformance, RunModelDiscoveryHarnessConformance all pass against &Runner{}. QuotaStatus/AccountStatus/DefaultModelSnapshot return well-formed zero-values (e.g. empty Windows slice, CapturedAt=time.Time{}) — the conformance suite verifies shape, not content.
4) builtinHarnesses['claude-tui'] is present in registry.go with the documented fields (empty BaseArgs, empty PermissionArgs, empty ModelFlag/ReasoningFlag/WorkDirFlag, IsSubscription=true, AutoRoutingEligible=false, Binary='claude'). A registry-shape regression test asserts these field values exactly.
5) execute_dispatch.go constructs claudetui.Runner when name='claude-tui'; a focused dispatch test asserts the dispatcher returns a *claudetui.Runner instance (or its harnesses.Harness wrapping) for that name.
6) The harnessimports lint rule passes; no service*.go imports internal/harnesses/claude-tui beyond execute_dispatch.go.
7) go test ./internal/harnesses/... -count=1 green; go test ./... -count=1 green; lefthook run pre-commit green.
